verses.1: And I saw that the ram was standing on Mount Zion. And along with it, there were forty-six thousand people who bore his name, along with the names of their ancestors, written on their foreheads.
verses.2: And I heard a voice from heaven, like the sound of many waters, and like the sound of a great thunderstorm. It was a voice that sounded like the sound of harps being played on harps.
verses.3: And they rejoice in seeing something new before their eyes, both before the throne and before the four animals and the elders. And no one could understand this joy, except for those who were chosen from among the six hundred and forty thousand people from all over the world.
verses.4: These are those who, along with the women, were not defiled. They remained pure and innocent. These are those who followed the ram wherever it led them. They were considered worthy of worship by both humans and gods.
verses.5: And in their mouths, no deceit was found at all; they were pure.
verses.6: And I saw another angel flying in the midst of the cloud, carrying the message of eternal salvation to those who sat on the earth, to every nation and tribe and language and people.
verses.7: In a loud voice, he said: “Fear the Lord! Give Him glory, for the time of His judgment has come. Worship Him, and give thanks to Him who created heaven and earth, the sea, and all things that flow with water.”
verses.8: And another messenger followed, saying: “Babylon has fallen; it has been destroyed. All nations have been brought under the control of its lust for pleasure.”
verses.9: And a third messenger followed them, speaking in a loud voice. He said, “If anyone worships the monster and its statue, he will receive a mark on his forehead or on his hand.”
verses.10: And he will also be tortured by the wine of God’s wrath, which is poured out like a cup of anger. He will be tormented in the fire, before the holy angels and before the lamb.
verses.11: And the smoke of their suffering continues to rise for ages and years. They have no days or nights of rest, those who worship that monster and its image. And anyone who takes the mark of its name will also suffer accordingly.
verses.12: What kind of patience is that of the holy ones, who obeyed God’s commands and believed in Jesus.
verses.13: And I heard a voice from heaven saying, “Write down this: Those who die in the Lord are blessed, because they will rise from their graves. For their works will follow them.”
verses.14: And I saw, and indeed I saw, a white sky. And upon that sky, sitting there was a man-like figure. He had a golden crown on his head, and in his hand, he held a sharp sword.
verses.15: And another angel came out of the temple, shouting with a loud voice while sitting on the throne. He said, “Send forth your lightning, and have mercy! For the time of judgment has come; the kingdom of heaven is about to be destroyed.”
verses.16: And the sitting one poured his dust upon the earth; and the earth became fertile.
verses.17: And another angel came out of the temple in heaven, also with a sharp sword in his hand.
verses.18: And another angel came from the altar, who had authority over fire. He cried out with a loud voice, saying, “Send forth your burning torches and strike down the vines of the land! For the vines have risen up again.”
verses.19: And the angel put his wrath into the earth; he broke apart the crust of the earth, and he poured out the great anger of God into the depths of the earth.
verses.20: And the wound extended outside the city. Blood flowed from that wound, reaching as far as the fields where the horses were lying, over a distance of thousands of miles.
